#!/usr/bin/env python3

import os
import sys
import csv
import pandas as pd

def main() -> None:
    # Path to the raw long‑format data
    input_path = "outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv"

    try:
        # Read the whole file as strings to avoid accidental dtype conversions
        df = pd.read_csv(input_path, dtype=str)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Error reading {input_path}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # Expected columns that identify a record
    id_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"]
    key_columns = id_columns + ["indicator_id"]

    # Check that the identifier columns exist
    missing = [c for c in key_columns if c not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        print(f"Missing expected columns in {input_path}: {missing}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    # Discover the column that contains the value.  It is the column that
    # is not one of the key columns and not 'indicator_id'.
    value_columns = [c for c in df.columns if c not in key_columns]
    if not value_columns:
        print(f"Could not find a value column in {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    value_col = value_columns[0]   # take the first one

    # Keep only the relevant columns
    df = df[key_columns + [value_col]]

    # Pivot: every indicator becomes a column
    pivot = df.pivot_table(
        index=id_columns,
        columns="indicator_id",
        values=value_col,
        aggfunc="first"    # should not happen to have many rows with same id
    )

    # Reset index so we have a flat DataFrame
    pivot = pivot.reset_index()

    # Flatten the column MultiIndex created by pivot_table
    pivot.columns = pivot.columns.to_list()

    # Build the desired column order: id columns followed by sorted indicator ids
    indicator_columns = sorted(df["indicator_id"].unique())
    all_columns = id_columns + indicator_columns
    pivot = pivot[all_columns]

    # Convert NaNs to empty strings so CSV cells stay empty when missing
    pivot = pivot.fillna("")

    # Prepare output directory
    output_path = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

    # Write the result – quoting minimal keeps unequal fields quoting only when needed
    pivot.to_csv(
        output_path,
        index=False,
        quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
